## Why

Raised by the ui in round 1 of ork run ork-20261125-204703-eec0 for S580 (discovered from S580).

While the Goals are lifted (S580: `pgup`, `up` or `home` on the first Roadmap row), the window can drop the cursor row below its end. At 80x10 after `home`, the frame shows only Goals lines and no Roadmap row. `enter` then opens `Item S90`, the first row, and nothing on screen says that row is selected.

Owner decision (adj 589, key `ui.goals-lift-enter-cue`, "Cursor cue", 2026-11-25): while the Goals are lifted, the marker shows the selected row, for example `cursor: S90`, and `enter` keeps opening that row. This slice adds the cue. It does not change which keys lift the Goals or end the lift (adj 578, 582).

## Implement

1. In `internal/tui/view.go`, change `window` to take a `note string` for the below marker. When `below` is true and the note is non-empty, the marker reads `+N more lines, cursor: S90`: the note is appended after a comma and a space. Callers other than `screen` pass `""`. The cue goes on the below marker because the above marker is absent when the lift reaches the Goals heading (start 0). With 3 or more body lines a lifted window always has a below marker. Below 3 lines `span` draws no markers, so no cue shows.
2. In `screen`, in the lift block (line 340), after `start -= m.roadmapLift.lines`, set `cue` to `"cursor: " + items[clampCursor(m.roadmapCursor, len(items))].ID` when `m.roadmapLift.lines > 0` and there is at least one item. Otherwise `cue` is empty.
3. In `screen`, empty `cue` in the `m.showHelp` branch (line 347), since the help overrides `start`. Pass `cue` to `window` at line 361.
4. `enter` is unchanged: `openItem` opens `items[clampCursor(m.roadmapCursor, len(items))]` (`internal/tui/roadmap.go:135`).
5. In `internal/tui/scroll_sweep_test.go`, change `sweepMarker` to `^\+\d+ (lines above|more lines)(, cursor: \S+)?$`. Add the cue case to `TestSweepMissingNamesSkippedLines`.
6. Add the two tests above to `internal/tui/roadmap_test.go`. Read the cue from `plainView(h.m)`. Open the item with `h.m.Update(press("enter"))` and read `h.m.itemPane.id`.
7. In `docs/dashboard.md` after line 2045, add one sentence: while the Goals are lifted, the `+N more lines` marker names the selected row (`cursor: S90`) and `enter` opens that row (adj 589).
8. Run `slicer changelog add S600 --text "Roadmap list: while the Goals are lifted, the marker names the selected row and enter opens it (adj 589)"`. Do not edit `CHANGELOG.md`.
